description:
Feel the rush with every drift on the Electric Green Machine! Designed for thrill-seekers, this drift trike takes excitement to the next level with powerful acceleration and smooth handling. Perfect for riders ready to crank up their drift game and enjoy non-stop fun.
Stay in control with the easy-to-read digital display, showing your speed and battery life at a glance. The convenient thumb throttle lets you accelerate effortlessly, keeping the excitement at your fingertips.
Stay informed on your battery’s status with convenient LED indicator lights that show the current charge level at a glance. With an estimated 4–6 hours for a full recharge, this 36V battery ensures you’re ready for extended drifting fun whenever adventure calls.
Feel the surge of power with the Green Machine’s 250W motor, delivering fast acceleration and smooth drifting. Designed for thrill-seekers, this motor adds an extra edge to every ride, letting you tackle drifts and spins with ease.
Find your perfect fit with the Green Machine’s adjustable seat, designed to move into multiple positions as riders grow. This feature ensures a secure, comfortable ride, giving you the ideal setup for tackling drifts and spins with confidence and ease.
